answer: The most convincing sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. Fresh accounts are never sampled, so mass-created fakes gain nothing. Each task draws a random quorum of bonded, seasoned graders who stake collateral on verdicts; collusion gets slashed, and honest verdicts ripple through the reputation layer. Standing grows like tending a garden: slow, capital-bound. Capturing a quorum means aging identities and locking stake slashing destroys — a mesa no forged shortcut climbs.
